data.one_liner: Display a beautifully animated, material context menu using pure Flutter
data.what_it_does: Displays an animated material context menu that works on both touch and desktop devices. It handles screen edges and oversize automatically. Developers can use the ContextMenuArea widget or trigger it manually.
use_when: You need to add a context menu to cards, text, or other widgets
You want a context menu that handles screen edges and touch or desktop devices
avoid_when: You are using a non-Material design system
You require complex platform-specific native context menu integrations
strengths: Works on both touch and desktop devices
Very efficient and lightweight code base
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration on web via index.html to disable native right-click menus
data.setup_notes: For web platforms, you must add `oncontextmenu="return false;"` in the `<body>` tag of your index.html.
